arguments.summary: User Sophia Silva is unhappy with the service received and requests cancellation of the travel insurance purchased for her flight reservation, along with a full refund of the insurance cost. The available tools do not support removing insurance from an existing reservation (policy only prohibits adding insurance after initial booking; no removal tool exists), so this request cannot be handled within scope and requires a human agent.
